_meta.description: Stack presets that select exercises for this team. Exercise ids resolve against the shared exercise catalog in ../../exercises/exercise-map.json (or the example map). Paths in that catalog point into the external exercises repo configured via 'hiring setup --exercises-repo'.
_meta.usage: Match the candidate stack to a preset, always include standard exercises, then add extended ones whose tags/seniority match the CV.

mandatory_for_p1.note: For P1, blended-with-P1, or P1-to-verify candidates, always include and run the 'maximum product of three integers' Python exercise. Do not replace it or make it optional.
